authorization.scope: New bounded offline source-construction successor scopes; synthetic tests. Not a runtime admission, worker-start receipt, installation, enrollment, egress permission or qualification. Prior one-use scopes remain historical.
authorization.instruction_precedence: The explicit approved offline successor scope permits direct source construction despite the older paeos-development skill ChatBridge-only rule. workspace_rule: Own isolated worktree from baseline; shared Git objects and recovery interpreter; no archive or venv copies. Preserve previous candidates and record their handoff first. Do not edit dirty main.

callback.when: One material completion, remand, changed blocker or actionable failure; not ACK-only. Human authorized callbacks and follow-up directly in the approved plan.

budget.scope: One bounded package; existing root/task ceilings remain, no reset or paid fallback. Reserve waiver does not remove hard quota.
budget.parallelism: Three substantive source workstreams maximum; one heavy test process under shared coordination test lock. Architect short turns only.

verification: Write discriminating tests first and record initial failure; run focused suite, Ruff lint/format, compile, diff checks, sanitized-manifest secret scan. Synthetic identities only; no host credentials/provider calls. Capture exact immutable candidate, explicit-manifest checkpoint, push and verify remote SHA. Do not claim full-suite or lifecycle acceptance from focused checks.
completion: Actual diff, command results, immutable SHA/hashes, source origins, preserved predecessor status, ALLOWED_NOW/HELD/AUTHORITY_OR_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP and exact next gate. Keep review findings untouched.
objective: Complete-frame enforcement at real broker ingress/direct send, immutable exact outbound bytes and destination. Distinct durable provider-frame claims and parent ordinal/root allowance. Preserve v1 exact-artifact policy; versioned approved-tool derivative policy never lowers input classification. Unsupported fields/references/legacy paths deny. Remove directory-derived production root authority; final installer uses reviewed closure and existing identities.
acceptance: Instructions/history/attachments/tools/results/unknown fields and injected/direct forwarder bypass negatives before signature/network.
Stable exact authorized bytes, no request-ID resets, no ambiguity retry, default-deny without authentic binding.
Bundle source/runtime separation and startup/negative control, original files/identities preserved.
Combined focused regression and full suite once; current errors recorded. Final exact candidate independent Security Review before installation/enrollment/canary.
next_gate: One guided reviewed signing/enrollment ceremony if human-only action required; no activation before applicable approval.
